audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD 8/10 contradicts the 49.84% WR over 2817 games (a coin-flip), and the full-layer chart (all Syndra) contradicts both the content chart and the packet chart (all Vex).
audit.why: Three sources — WR, packet levelChart, content win[] — say even-to-slight-Vex; only the full layer says hard Syndra. Kit-wise Syndra has no dash (weak Vex passive) but her only setup is a 15s E, which Vex R punishes.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, tone #e8b84b, diffRating 5.5/10; carryRating 8.5/10 kept (her R execute threat is real). All 7 full sides moved to Vex to agree with content win[] and packet, ratings 6/10, whys rewritten to the disciplined-edge argument the content layer already makes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose was the dash-fear template ('every trade he answers with a dash') against a champion with zero dashes; misgendered throughout.
audit.why: Syndra is female (MC_IS_FEMALE) and immobile; her spikes are E-stun setup, R 120s execute, Splinter scaling.
audit.corrected: Trading, early/mid/late breakdowns and dos/donts rebuilt around Scatter the Weak's 15s cooldown, the sphere-line stun geometry, and her R execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: full layer named no Syndra abilities beyond E; cooldowns field had no digits; her P/W bonus TRUE damage (resistances-invalidated missing interaction) never surfaced.
audit.why: Kit: Q Dark Sphere 7s flat, W Force of Will 12-8s (true damage upgrade), E Scatter the Weak 15s flat (stun via spheres), R Unleashed Power 120/100/80 with execute upgrade.
audit.corrected: Real names and numbers in cooldowns/trading/whys; true-damage note recorded (MR stacking is not the answer — Zhonya's/positioning are, which report[8] already carries).
